{{Quote|Plunk. Plunk.|A plunk droid|audio=PlunkPlunk-SoM.flac|<ref name="SOM" />}}
'''PLNK-series power droids''', nicknamed "'''plunk droids'''" for their distinctive vocalizations, were four-legged [[Power droid/Legends|power droids]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They spoke a form of [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]] similar to [[Gonkian/Legends|Gonkian]] and functioned as containment and refueling units for liquid [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]], which they equipped various [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and equipment with. Though not built with the near-limitless capacity of standard power [[Droid/Legends|droids]], their tibanna-driven generators were enough to provide the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening posts]] with sufficient power to execute their needs. The droids served the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], working aboard [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]; as well as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], counting [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] that passed through the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]]. PLNK-series units were also used on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-affiliated [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:PLNK-series_power_droid.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A PLNK-series power droid]]
The PLNK-series [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] was designed for storing and refueling liquid [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]].<ref name="SG" /> They were additionally built for refueling [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and equipment and performed simple tasks in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and military bases.<ref name="TCWCE" /> To increase their capacity for tibanna, the droids were based on a "stretched" designed of the [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]] and had four legs, as opposed to the two of the GNK series.<ref name="SG" /> Lacking both weapons and a [[Gender/Legends|programmed gender]], the PLNK-series were equipped with feet that allowed them to waddle along.<ref name="TCWCE" /> They had a slow moving pace, weighed down by a heavy internal tibanna tank and tibanna-powered generator. A single unit carried an internal pump for loading and discharging liquid tibanna through its externally mounted hose and nozzle;<ref name="SG" /> the fuel hose ran from the droid's left side to the nozzles holstered on its back.<ref name="R" /> Their actions could be controlled by a main panel for system diagnostics located on their front side.<ref name="TCWCE" /> The droids spoke a form of [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]] similar to [[Gonkian/Legends|Gonkian]],<ref name="SOM" /> saying "plunk" as they shuffled about and hence earning them the nickname "plunk droids." They also understood [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] but were unable to speak it.<ref name="SG" />

Although unequipped with the near-limitless power generation of a standard power droid, each PLNK-series model possessed a tibanna-driven generator that was capable of supplying enough power to satisfy the needs of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening posts]] until its tibanna supply ran out.<ref name="SG" /> Three plunk droids were enough to power a single listening post and could alternatively be used as detonators to destroy an outpost in case of enemy insurgency.<ref name="R" /> In the service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], plunk droids were thought to have some defective circuits that led to miscalculation.<ref name="SOD" /> Like other power droids, plunk droids were encased in heavy shielding,<ref name="SG" /> mainly over their fuel reservoirs,<ref name="TCWCE" /> and colored [[Duranium/Legends|duranium]] plating<ref name="SG" />&mdash;ranging from dark green<ref name="SOM" /> to gray,<ref name="R" /> brown,<ref name="JC" /> and gold<ref name="SS" />&mdash;to safeguard their highly flammable tibanna contents. To further protect their cargo, the units featured heightened security and safety protocols, but were still restricted by highly limited programming and artificial intelligence. The droids' self-preservation programming sometimes gave them cause to run away from their owners when "spooked" or agitated.<ref name="SG" />

==History==
{{Quote|One of those plunk droids probably miscounted again. Their circuits are defective.|A B1 battle droid|<ref name="SOD" />}}
PLNK-series power droids had begun to be manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SG" /> They were in the service of the Separatists, counting [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] passing through the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]] to the [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries/Legends|Gwori Revolutionary Industries]] [[Gwori shipyards|shipyards]]. When [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] noticed one too many freighters in a convoy, they dismissed it as a calculation error made by the plunk droids, whom they claimed possessed defective circuits.<ref name="SOD" /> Plunk droids were also used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to refuel [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] introduced during the war<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref> that, unlike most [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], relied on liquid tibanna instead of [[Power fusion generator|fusion generators]] as a power source.<ref name="TCWCE" /> The droids served aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] in the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] of the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]]<ref name="SOM" /><ref name="JC" /><ref name="SOR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref><ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> and could be seen shuffling about the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the vessel, where Y-wing bombers,<ref name="SOM" /> [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]],<ref name="JC" /> [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptors]], and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] were housed.<ref name="SOR" />

[[File:Plunkplunk.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] ushers a plunk droid in Rishi Station.]]
A trio of plunk droids, containing liquid tibanna, served as the power source for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] listening post [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]] on the [[Rishi moon]], which was used to monitor a portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for possible invasion by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. When Separatist [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|captured]] the station, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] manning the facility decided that it was necessary to destroy the installation to warn [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the site of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities, of the impending Separatist attack. The [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] rounded up the three plunk droid units<ref name="R" /> and wired them together<ref name="R-EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> in order to detonate them using a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal charge]]. When the remote detonator failed to sync up with the charge, clone trooper [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] sacrificed himself to manually trigger the device, destroying the three plunk droids along with the installation.<ref name="R" />

Plunk droids were used on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], where one such droid stepped in to fuel [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]] after he landed in [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]] to [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|intercept]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].<ref name="COTF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref> The droids were additionally employed by the Republic on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and were involved in preparations for the departure of the Royal [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[J-type star skiff]], which was to take [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] to a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|diplomatic meeting]] with Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="SS" /> Shortly afterward, plunk droids were dispatched with a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] sent to [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|invade]] the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and halt the production of Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] droid foundries there. The power droids were present aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of the fleet when the initial body of troops was deployed.<ref name="LAPR" /> [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="The Mandalore Plot Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode212.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> made use of plunk droids<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> in one of its spaceports,<ref name="The Mandalore Plot Ep Guide" /> where the units were sometimes observed by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] civilians during their operations.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" /><ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

[[File:RenownPLNK-PoNR.png|thumb|right|200px|A yellow plunk droid on the ''Renown''.]]
A yellow PLNK power droid served along on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' when it was hijacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When droids of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] hijacked a Republic cruiser, all clone personal and crew members were all killed but this droid and a small group of others led by [[BNI-393/Legends|BNI-393]]. when [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] led by [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] came aboard the starship, the droid survivors hoped to escape with them until a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] was caught spying on the droids. [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] then chased the spy in pursuit to the gunnery room where the rest followed&mdash;except this droid stayed behind at D-Squad's [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. He was later returned under the protection of the Republic after they escaped the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' that was full of [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]]. The droid along with the others were all assigned to the same [[Platoon/Legends|Platoon]] for the rest of the war as it escalated its destructive path.<ref name="PONR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Plunk droids were created for the [[2008]] [[Wikipedia:Animation|animated]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and first appeared in the background of the episode "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," which aired on [[October 10]]. The droids were first named in the [[StarWars.com]] episode guide for "Shadow of ''Malevolence''." They later had a more active role in the [[October 24]] episode, "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," and could be seen once again ambling around a hangar bay in "[[Jedi Crash]]" as well as "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]." They were also used in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], appearing extensively in the background of scenes in multiple episodes. They were given the "PLNK-series power droid" designation in the 2009 ''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]], which also greatly expanded the droids' features. The appearance of plunk droids is very similar to that of the GNK and [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6]] droids of the [[Original trilogy|original ''Star Wars'' trilogy]]. In an [[Ready for Battle!|interview]] published in [[Star Wars Insider 115|''Star Wars Insider'' 115]], ''The Clone Wars'' Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] states that the name "plunk droid," as well as the sound that the droids make, is a play on the name of designer [[Kilian Plunkett]].<ref name="Ready for Battle">{{InsiderCite|115|Ready for Battle!}}</ref> Plunk droids also appeared in the [[2011]] non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' that adapted "Rookies."
